decisions.decision: Adopted two-arm quasi-experimental pretest-posttest design with G*Power sample calculation (N=60, power=0.865).
decisions.rationale: High statistical power to detect medium-to-large effect sizes (f=0.25-0.38) while maintaining ethical control arm.

decisions.decision: Selected ANCOVA with baseline pre-test as covariate rather than raw repeated-measures ANOVA gain scores.
decisions.rationale: Controls for regression to the mean and baseline error variance, yielding higher statistical power.
alternatives_considered: Independent samples t-test on change scores

decisions.decision: Scored MBI and AAQ-II using validated reverse-coding keys from psychometric scale registry.
decisions.rationale: Maintains psychometric construct validity and alignment with published norms.

decisions.decision: Retained standard Persian leading zero in all reported APA numbers
decisions.rationale: Compliance with Directive 4 and Persian OpenXML academic standards
